# ResultSniper BD (ResultSniper BD — Shahriyar Sojib Hasan)
> Fast, resilient Bangladesh Education Board Result Extraction, Merit Analytics & 1-Page A4/Letter Cryptographically Verified Marksheet Platform (English default + Bangla toggle).

## Creator & Lead Developer
- **Name**: Shahriyar Sojib Hasan
- **Role**: Software Architect & Lead Developer
- **Live URL**: https://resultsniper-bd.vercel.app
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/shahriyarsojibhasan/ResultSniper-BD

## Architecture & Live API Engines
1. **eduboardresults.gov.bd (Official Full Marks Engine)**: Fetches candidate profiles and subject-wise numerical marks (`getStudentResult`) with human-solved 6-char captcha.
2. **result.bangladeshgov.org (All-Board / EBR Mirror Gateway)**: Supports SSC, HSC, JSC, DIBS across all 11 Education Boards (2015–2026) with `sub_details` resolution and 4-digit security key.
3. **api.ebr.bd (EBR Leaderboard API)**: Protected upstream by Cloudflare Turnstile bound to `ebr.bd`; server route `/api/ebr/check` reports Turnstile gate status transparently and hands off cleanly to Full Marks / All-Board gateways.

## Security & 1-Page Print PDFs
- **Light Currency Wave Underprint**: Soft pastel guilloche curves, rosettes, microtext frame, and dynamic official board emblems (including transparent official PNG crest for Rajshahi Board).
- **1-Page A4 & US Letter Fit**: Both main marksheet print and `/verify` certificate fit cleanly onto a single A4 or Letter page.
- **HMAC-SHA256 Verification**: Stateless compressed payload + signature embedded in QR code (`/verify?t=<TOKEN>`).

## Endpoints
- `GET /`: Bilingual (EN default / BN toggle) multi-engine UI.
- `GET /verify?t={token}`: Public verification portal + 1-page A4/Letter printable certificate.
- `GET /api/verify?t={token}`: JSON verification endpoint.
- `GET /health`: Health check endpoint for 24/7 cloud uptime monitors.
- `GET /about`, `/terms`, `/privacy`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/llms.txt`
